🟠 [2a-intake-seal-missing] MUST-FIX Spec §2 explicitly requires `src/engine/campaign-intake.js` (+ codex mirror) to seal `final_panel_reserve_seconds` and `full_suite_reuse` into `initial_state.limits` with defaults when absent; neither file appears in the diff. Add the intake sealing (defaults 0/true) in both campaign-intake.js paths, matching the sealed output_paths list.
